message: Legacy careerRanks describe a path, not dated history; only the exact current rank was projected.
Legacy movement has no V2 core field and is preserved only in legacyExtensions.
Experience earned was inferred as current plus spent.
Skill advance has no exact legacy skill owner and is preserved only in legacyExtensions.
Inventory id "legacy.weapon.0000" and quantity 1 were deterministically inferred.
Inventory id "legacy.armour.0000" and quantity 1 were deterministically inferred.
Inventory id "legacy.trapping.0000" and quantity 1 were deterministically inferred.
Legacy data had no trustworthy lifecycle timestamps; caller-supplied timestamps were used.
